recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not remove MedicationStatement.partOf for FHIR-31508 unless Pharmacy resolves FHIR-57403 or another final tracker with new instructions.
issue_request: FHIR-31508 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested removal of MedicationUsage.partOf because partOf did not make sense for the then-listed MedicationAdministration, MedicationStatement, or MedicationDispense relationships; the resolution said existing use cases should use basedOn or derivedFrom instead.
initial_application: Commit 7453f87bfcb5eeba6020113412508cb95e5d4f0a, whose subject included FHIR-31508, removed MedicationUsage.partOf, the MedicationUsage part-of search parameter, and example partOf content.
additional_context: FHIR-36001 later explicitly revisited FHIR-31508 and restored partOf for an overlooked Procedure use case. FHIR-38690 then added a MedicationUsage-to-MedicationUsage parent/child use case and examples. FHIR-38682 renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement. FHIR-57403 is a newer Submitted issue questioning whether to explain or remove the current element, but it is not final.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current active source intentionally retains MedicationStatement.partOf as Reference(Procedure|MedicationStatement), reflecting later final decisions rather than a missed seed application.
